prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for adoption changes (hint, new flow, redesign) and home notifications, as each has only a single test.
Finish new screen changes (finish, new_screen) proved helpful, with both tests showing positive noise-corrected gains (+1.0% and +2.0%) and one winning test.
Path layout changes (choose_path, layout) can be helpful, producing one clear winner (+5.5% after noise correction) across 3 tests.
Home wait info changes (home, wait_info) showed no clear effect across 2 tests.
Sign-in hint changes (sign_in, hint) yielded one winning test (+3.3% after noise correction), though a second test showed no clear effect.
Initial predictions in Round 1 were overly optimistic, but underpredicted winning tests in Round 2 (path layout) and Round 3 (finish new screen).

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: +0.6% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, new_flow: -4.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- choose_path, layout: +1.8% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- finish, new_screen: +1.6% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- home, notification: +1.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.7% after noise correction, 2 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.3% after noise correction, 2 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 80.6%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 69.5%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.3%

"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Move Sign-In After Adoption Selection: Move the sign-in step to occur after pet adoption selection so users build an affinity with their pet before creating an account. (why: Early sign-in causes high drop-off (76.9% step conversion) and users lack context on why account creation is needed until after adopting.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Two-Column Layout Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a two-column grid with live pet previews and trait badges. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (60.9%) and long median decision time (89s), indicating choice paralysis.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Cheat Sheet Screen: Add a dedicated cheat sheet screen at the end of onboarding explaining hotkeys, dragging, and hiding desktop controls. (why: 3 support tickets reported post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or talk to the pet.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Guided Photo Upload Best Practices Flow: Insert a photo guidelines step before custom photo upload to demonstrate clear lighting and pose requirements. (why: 3 support tickets noted custom pet generation failures or wrong looks, contributing to adoption step friction.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Cloud Restore Hint: Add an explicit hint on sign-in clarifying that logging in restores existing pets automatically. (why: 8 support emails were received about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
5: [home, wait_info] Generation Stage Progress Checklist: Show a clear progress checklist and estimated timer while pet graphics and desktop hooks are generating. (why: Home wait step has a mean duration of 2336s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear or app stalling.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Spotlight Path Selection Layout: Reframe path selection into a spotlight layout placing focus clearly on ready-made vs custom adoption. (why: 19.4% of users drop off at path selection; previous path layout changes provided significant positive gains (+5.5%).)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification Switch: Enable desktop system tray notifications when pet startup finishes and the pet is visible. (why: 3 support emails reported confusion over pets not appearing on screen after setup.)
8: [adoption, copy] Adoption Certificate Reassurance Copy: Update certificate screen headline and body text to emphasize permanent account cloud registration. (why: Deepens emotional connection during adoption and reduces user anxiety around pet data loss.)
9: [choose_path, hint] Path Choice Flexibility Hint: Add a reassuring hint explaining that users can create or switch pets anytime later in settings. (why: Mean time spent on path selection is high (514s), indicating hesitation and fear of making an irreversible choice.)

scores.note: Reordering sign-in reduces early friction, but structural flow changes require full release.
Adoption has highest drop-off (39.1%) and long time; redesign is promising but costly.
Finish new screens consistently perform well in past tests (+1.6% avg), addressing reported tickets.
Adding flow steps to adoption step lost conversion (-4.4%) in previous test.
8 support emails pinpoint sign-in account restore confusion; hints showed past wins.
Home wait info showed minimal effect (+0.7%) in past tests despite long mean wait times.
Path selection layout changes produced the strongest historical winner (+5.5%).
Low cost config change; notifications have positive but limited test evidence.
Low-cost copy update on the highest drop-off step to relieve user anxiety.
High mean hesitation time (514s) on path choice targeted with simple text hint.
